claims: Kennesaw State University (KSU) is a public R2 research university in Georgia.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) has over 38,000 students.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) has campuses in Kennesaw and Marietta.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) is the third-largest university in Georgia.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) offers over 190 degree programs.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) has 16 Division I NCAA teams.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) shifted to Conference USA athletics in 2025.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) has two metro-Atlanta campuses in Kennesaw and Marietta, Georgia.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) Owls compete at the NCAA Division I level in Conference USA.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) offers over 190 undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) has 11 academic colleges.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) has the College of Computing and Software Engineering.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) has "Double Owl Pathways" which allow students to accelerate their undergraduate and graduate studies.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) football transitioned to the Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS).
Kennesaw State University (KSU) football became bowl-eligible in 2025.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) men's basketball team competes in Conference USA.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) men's basketball team moved from the Atlantic Sun Conference.
As of 2009–10, all 16 Kennesaw State University (KSU) varsity teams fully transitioned to Division I.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) provides a suburban campus setting within the metro Atlanta area.
Kennesaw State University (KSU) is a Carnegie-designated doctoral research institution (R2).
